name: Fin de Siglo
description: Online bookstore of Editorial Fin de Siglo, a Uruguayan publisher, selling books in categories such as narrative, history, politics, children's and music. States free shipping nationwide on orders above a threshold.
description_es: Tienda en línea de libros de la Editorial Fin de Siglo, editorial uruguaya, con narrativa, historia, política, infantiles y música. Informa envío gratis a todo el país sobre un monto mínimo.

ships_to.notes: Store states free shipping to the whole country above a minimum order; carriers Correo Uruguayo, Marco Postal (Montevideo) and DAC (interior)

shopping_notes: WooCommerce store under /tienda/. Delivery options and free-shipping threshold are on the Ayuda y Privacidad page.

sources.supports: free shipping nationwide above stated minimum
carriers and delivery options for Montevideo and interior
